notes: A 2007 map, older than any convention for labelling a zone, and built for two teams: everything on the route exists twice, once per side, mirrored about x. Its own names are the only ordering there is -- stage02_t/stage02_ct and stage03_t/stage03_ct -- so stage 1 is the start room and the stage zones cover both sides of the pair. It ends in a prison: finishing the last section teleports to jail_pro and failing it teleports to jail_noob, which is as clear a statement of which one is the finish as a map from 2007 is going to make.

zones.note: the start room, both team platforms
between the two platforms, facing -Y down the map; the team spawns face along +X, which is sideways
jail_pro is where finishing puts you; jail_noob, beside it, is where failing does
